contentPattern: One row per contact card. Cell 1 (optional): icon image. Cell 2: rich text - a short message, or a title followed by phone-number links each with a description line, or a list of links. A paragraph in cell 2 that starts with an inline icon image is rendered as an icon + content row (one per contact channel).
usage: Stacked contact-channel cards (chat, phone numbers, ombudsman / sign-language / form links) beside a section heading on contact, contract and ombudsman pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for vertical stacks of contact or support channels with an icon and short text or links. For grids of feature cards use cards-feature; for link-only cards use cards-links.
